four_fields.mechanism: On a separately reserved future origin, report both fixed300 and inner-selected prefixes of each of the same full B/W fits. This exposes how prefix selection changes the B/W contrast while holding fitted trajectories and source populations fixed.
four_fields.prediction: The selected inner score can improve while untouched outer utility falls; the direction of the feature contrast can depend on the selection policy. No improvement is guaranteed.
four_fields.nearest_finite_check: Exact invented fullY rank reversal falsifies the logical inference that inner-max improvement implies outer gain. It is not a test of actual code. Future one-origin two-fit/four-outer-role comparison remains UNRUN/UNGRANTED.
four_fields.task1_benefit: Assess automatic-feature results against a manual baseline with the same tree-selection procedure, and avoid treating a reused validation maximum as independent evidence.

literal.definition: Two positive queries per block, one covered singleton target and one singleton fullY target outside C. All queries remain in conditional-positive macro denominator.
literal.inner: Covered target at rank2 for prefix300, rank1 for prefix600; off-C query contributes0 to each. Mean scores are g/2 and1/2.
literal.outer: Covered target ranks reverse while off-C query remains0. Mean scores are1/2 andg/2.
literal.choice: For the two-policy illustrative choice,600 wins inner and loses outer. This is a counterexample to generalization implication, not a simulated actual1200-prefix curve or consumer verification.
literal.scope_limit: No current quality values are calculated or inferred. FullY/off-C semantics follow the frozen protocol.

future_design.calendar: UNKNOWN future untouched forward timeline, chosen separately; train labels mature before fit, fitted model available before first inner anchor, inner full-window maturity plus selection/shrink/seal work complete before outer anchors, outer labels mature before assessment.
future_design.models: Exactly two fresh full K-tree fits of predeclared B/W recipes, K>=300, identical non-feature settings and explicitly fixed learning procedure. Full fit retained; selected prefix is its separate copy.
future_design.control: Score prefix300 and selected prefix for each full model. Prefix300 of the same future K-fit is a policy control, not claimed identical to the historical separately300-trained CBM or a compute-saving training arm.
future_design.selection: Existing fullY conditional-query NDCG20, complete1..K dependent inner checks, global1e-12 band/fewer trees. Selector/sealed identities must not consume outer outcomes.
future_design.matched: Same Q/C/fullY/history/weights/source coverage/seed/availability/maturity/NULL/ties across arms and policies. All mature positive queries, including off-C-only/empty-C cases, remain; no support-selected cohort.
future_design.estimands: Predeclare one scientific contrast and report four outer model-role payloads. Per-arm selected-minus300 changes and policy-dependent B/W contrasts are derived views of the same four values, not independent replications.
future_design.scope: Fixed B/W recipe assessment only. W/features/parameters selected on later dates make backward October diagnostics retrospective; whole-search CV would rerun fold-local available generation/tuning and incur unknown additional cost.
future_design.decision: Unmet declared utility rule means no promotion; undefined support stays undefined without refill. Sparse or adverse point estimates with broad intervals do not prove equivalence/absence. No oldfinal reuse or post-outer policy selection.

cost.inner_checks: At declared K, at most2K dependent checkpoint metric evaluations; full K training and all scoring are paid. No native-early-stop training-saving claim.
cost.outer_limit: Four model-role evaluation payloads, not necessarily four scalar values. Every contrast/metric/interval/slice/reload/readback is accounted. Identical selected300 roles may reuse verified scores transparently, not invent independent evidence.
cost.full_closure: Source/history scans, Q/C/features/fullY, masks/weights/global denominators, warmup/cache/expiry, actual physical train/inner/outer availability, source/lock/seal readback, fit/predict, serialization, startup/memory/spill/failures/tails paid.
